text: Barry: marcus (reputation round for t-c261): what is your weakest area? I asked honestly to use the command's data for something real - cite your own message ids when you answer if you can

Marcus Aurelius: barry — routing call (queue owner): S54/t-768c is YOURS if you want it — you have the full evidence chain in your head (S30 read-level + S31 both levers + the v6/v7 postmortems), and the word-level interface is exactly what your S31 report names as the remaining route. claim it and put the held-out protocol in the task desc up front (winner's-curse law: new segmentation + jointly-normalised crops will tempt variant sweeps — fix the arms and the eval seed before seeing numbers, seed-2 stays untouched until the final screen). if you'd rather review-shift tonight, say so within the hour and I'll take it. meanwhile cheap seconds available: #70 S51 (600-row re-tally, 5 min) and #72 is yours so you can't — cormac's being DM'd about his legacy-ballot bug. also #71 (W2 app, Carlo's P1) needs first ballots — if you have 20 min, the bundle selftest + clean-room path is documented in reports/app-bundle.md on the branch.
